Inferra | Bare-Metal GPU Infra + Applied AI | San Francisco / REMOTE | Full-time / internship

We're looking for cracked, optimistic engineers/students with good systems taste and high tolerance of ambiguity. We're a team of ~10 in SF, building a GPU neocloud. High agency, lots of freedom, very little boundaries.

Think GPU datacenter bring-up, storage, networking, and designing IaC. Also think optimizing AI workloads, env design, minimizing GPU bring up times, and maximizing hardware fungibility.

Email sasan at inferra.ai with anything relevant. For internships: please tell what you'd like to do in the next ~year, if you could do anything.
